94:t_006:19.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, Big Sis! I'll assist you with all my heart!」

94:t_006:20.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I would've teamed up with $$ニコラ$$, but this one keeps clinging to me, so...」

94:t_006:21.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Did you say something, Big Sis?」

94:t_006:22.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Nothing! Let's hurry up and take out these pests!」

94:t_006:23.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain, it appears they intend to fight the Unknowns on their own.」

94:t_006:24.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They're not our enemy, so we can afford to ignore them. More than that, I'm concerned about why they came here.」

94:t_006:25.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Understood. I'll call on all units to stay alert.」

94:t_006:26.en:
$$アルト$$
「If it's come to this, we'll act like they aren't here! We'll handle it by ourselves!」

94:t_006:27.en:
$$勝平$$
「We'll show those guys what we can do instead!」

94:t_006:28.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Yeah! We'll take them all out by ourselves!」

94:t_006:29.en:
$$ニコラ$$
($c... I'll see what you can do.)

94:t_007:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「How condescending can this guy get?」

94:t_007:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If that offended you, I apologize. We came here to cooperate with you.」

94:t_007:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...$$ニコラ$$! Here they come!」

94:t_008:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Even we ended up with a score of zero... You're really something, $c.」

94:t_008:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「How condescending can this guy get?」

94:t_008:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If that offended you, I apologize. We came here to cooperate with you.」

94:t_008:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...$$ニコラ$$! Here they come!」

94:t_009:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Monsters! Monsters showed up in space!」

94:t_009:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Exactly. Those are the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

94:t_010:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「They're known as the $$木星急行$$. Normally they're a type that circles Jupiter space over and over as their route.」

94:t_010:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Since transferring to this world, they've been active throughout the entire solar system.」

94:t_010:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We took out a fair number of them the other day, but it seems some survived.」

94:t_010:3.en:
$$チコ$$
「And there's even a $$ビーストロン級$$ among them...!」

94:t_010:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Could it be... you're here to fight those $$宇宙怪獣$$?」

94:t_010:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We'll deal with them. You all fall back.」

94:t_010:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I appreciate the thought, but protecting humanity from the $$宇宙怪獣$$ is our job.」

94:t_010:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's right. No need to hold back.」

94:t_010:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「There's a huge number of them...! Let's fight with everyone's strength!」

94:t_010:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Cool!! That's exactly what champions of justice are like!」

94:t_010:16.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...Fine. If that's how you want it, we'll fall back.」

94:t_010:18.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If they can beat those $$宇宙怪獣$$, we'll just act as originally planned. Now let's go, $$姫$$.」

94:t_011:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Ignore them! Our enemy is the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

94:t_011:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis! Let's fight together with everyone in $c!」

94:t_011:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$ says it wants to fight with everyone too!」

94:t_011:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ディスヌフ$$ is MY $$バスターマシン$$! Don't put words in its mouth!」

94:t_011:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What do we do, $$ニコラ$$?」

94:t_011:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Big Sis! It's not about $$ニコラ$$ or anything like that, so fight of your own free will!」

94:t_011:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because you're a champion of justice, Big Sis!」

94:t_011:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノリリ$$ always fought for everyone! A champion of justice is always for everyone's sake!」

94:t_012:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「What are you going to do, $$ニコラ$$? Are you going to let $$姫$$ fight alone?」

94:t_012:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...It can't be helped. We're going too.」

94:t_013:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What are those guys doing?」

94:t_013:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I'm not sure, but it looks like they'll fight alongside us.」

94:t_013:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! Everyone in $c, please take good care of us!」

94:t_013:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Later, $$ノノ$$! First we hit the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

94:t_013:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, Big Sis! $$ノノ$$ will give it her all too!」

94:t_014:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Our real mission starts from here.」

94:t_014:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...You're serious, aren't you, $$ニコラ$$?」

94:t_014:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(That's what those girls on $$タイタン$$ wish for, after all.)

94:t_014:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Members of $$トップレス$$... We'd like to hear about the $$宇宙怪獣$$. Could you land on our ship?」

94:t_014:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Gladly. As I said earlier, we came here to cooperate with you.」

94:t_015:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So, do you understand our real ability now?」

94:t_015:2.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(Do try your best. Otherwise there's no point in my having come here.)

94:t_017:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's Big Sis for you! With hard work and guts...」
